Investigate application, configuration, integration, infrastructure, and performance-related customer issues. Analyze application logs, configuration files, diagnostic data, error messages, thread dumps, and other technical information to identify possible causes and next troubleshooting steps. Reproduce customer-reported issues in internal environments and develop clear test scenarios. Manage assigned customer cases and maintain ownership of investigation and communication through resolution. Prioritize multiple cases based on severity, customer impact, and business urgency. Recognize when an issue may originate outside the application layer and collect the appropriate technical evidence before engaging other teams. Communicate investigation progress, technical findings, solutions, and next steps clearly to customers and internal stakeholders. Document troubleshooting steps, root-cause findings, solutions, and workarounds. Contribute to Knowledge Base articles and other reusable technical documentation. Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve troubleshooting processes, documentation, and customer experience. Continuously develop technical knowledge of Teamcenter and its underlying technology stack. Required Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. 3-5 years of hands-on experience in technical support, application support, systems engineering, or a similar technical role. Experience troubleshooting enterprise or server-based software applications. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to technical problem solving. Working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems, including command-line tools, services, processes, permissions, and file systems. Understanding fundamental networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, proxies, firewalls, ports, certificates, and client/server communication. Experience reviewing and analyzing application or system logs. Ability to manage multiple technical issues and organize work according to priority and customer impact. Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly and apply new knowledge to customer problems. Initiative and the ability to work increasingly independently following the initial training and onboarding period. Good judgment in recognizing when additional technical expertise or escalation is required. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Professional proficiency in English is required, as English is the primary working language across our global Support and Engineering organization. Ability to explain technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to collaborate effectively within a geographically distributed global team. Preferred Qualifications Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable: Java or Java-based enterprise applications, particularly application troubleshooting. Apache HTTP Server and web application architectures. Subversion (SVN) administration or troubleshooting. Relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL. AWS or other cloud infrastructure and services. Enterprise authentication technologies such as SAML, OAuth/OIDC, LDAP, Active Directory, or SSO. REST APIs and integration troubleshooting. SQL and basic database troubleshooting. JVM configuration, heap/thread dump analysis, or Java application performance troubleshooting. Load balancers, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS certificates, and enterprise network architectures Familiarity with enterprise engineering tools such as Jira, IBM DOORS, Simulink, Azure DevOps, or Teamcenter. Previous experience with Teamcenter is a significant advantage but is not required. Experience supporting other complex Java-based enterprise applications is highly relevant. Training and Development We recognize that Teamcenter is a complex enterprise platform with a broad technology stack. New team members receive an onboarding and training period that includes product training, technical knowledge transfer, shadowing experienced engineers, and exposure to real customer cases. During onboarding, you will have access to experienced team members who can provide guidance and help you build product knowledge. Because this is an Advanced-level position, we expect you to build on your existing technical support experience, pick up new concepts quickly, become comfortable making technical decisions, and progress toward independently handling your workload and customer cases. Strong problem-solving skills are essential, including the ability to investigate complex issues, ask the right questions, research unfamiliar technologies, collaborate effectively with technical experts, and determine appropriate next steps toward resolution. The position is based around Pacific (and/or Asia Pacific) Time Zone business hours, with some flexibility in the daily schedule. As part of a global organization, there may occasionally be opportunities to adjust your schedule slightly to collaborate with colleagues or attend meetings across different time zones. What Success Looks Like As you complete onboarding and develop your Teamcenter knowledge, you will become increasingly comfortable managing customer cases independently. You will be able to assess an issue, collect the appropriate technical information, perform an initial investigation, and determine reasonable next troubleshooting steps. For more complex issues, you will know when and how to collaborate with experienced engineers, Engineering, or other technical teams. You will have daily support, collaboration, and technical resources from your immediate team, as well as access to our global Support organization and subject matter experts across different regions and time zones. Our collaborative environment provides opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues, exchange knowledge, and work together on complex technical challenges. Successful engineers in this role are curious, proactive, organized, accountable, and comfortable learning continuously. They take responsibility for moving their cases forward while recognizing that complex problems are often solved through teamwork. Why us? Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday
